title: Herbaceous German Chickpea Bowl
description: A light, herb‑rich bowl of chickpeas tossed in a zesty red‑wine‑vinegar bhuna, topped with fresh German‑style herbs and crunchy rye croutons.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a non‑stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and the spice blend; sauté until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Stir in the sliced red onion and cook until softened, 2–3 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, halved cherry tomatoes, and the remaining tbsp of olive oil; season with salt and pepper. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Whisk together the red wine vinegar and Dijon mustard, then pour over the chickpea mixture.
Simmer the mixture for another 3 minutes, letting the flavors meld and the tomatoes slightly soften.
Transfer the chickpea bhuna to bowls and top with the chopped fresh herbs and rye croutons.
Squeeze fresh lime juice over each bowl and serve immediately.
Optional: garnish with extra herbs or a drizzle of olive oil for added richness.
